column1: # The build workload for bench/run.sh, in its own file because it needs
# --assets: a directory holding lua-5.4.8.tar.gz and a SHA256SUMS that
# lists it (bench/assets.sha256 is the pinned value to copy there).
# Every run extracts a clean tree into its own new {RUNDIR} and builds it
# with make -j4; the extraction is inside the timed region. It prints the
# number of compiler invocations make ran ("cc=N"), to compare with native.
